text_block_list.text:
Neither Mayano nor Akebono have arrived
yet...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
They haven't retired from the race either...
I wonder if something
happened to them.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Wait... Don't tell me you used the slide
on—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Non non! I certainly did not, Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Right now, those two are discovering their
own beauty... It's nothing
more than
that. ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Several hours earlier...
One, two! One, two!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's stopped chasing after me, so
I must really be in the lead!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Once I get my very own wedding dress,
everyone's gonna swoon over
me! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
What beauty! I've never seen such a
captivating Umamusume before!
text_block_list.name: Handsome Guy

text_block_list.text:
Such beauty, such grace... I wish I could be
like yooouuu! ♪
text_block_list.name: Sexy Lady

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! No one has more mature charm
than Маяно Топ Ган, that's
for sure!
text_block_list.name: Popular Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Ooh! I'm such a catch! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding! I'd better hurry to the goal
if I want to make my dream
come true!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Eek! What's with the suspension bridge?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
If I were to fall from this height, I'd be in a
world of pain...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But I have to cross it! I've gotta be brave
and charming like real,
grown-up women
are!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ♪ This is kinda fun now that I've
gotten used to it! It's just like
an obstacle
course!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to take off and soar all the
way to the chapel! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...YAAA!
MAYAAA!
Huh? That voice... Bono?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard her voice, but I don't see
her... Bono! Where are
you?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Down here! Below the bridge!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Below? Wait, are you on the cliff?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow. Thank goodness you noticed
me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, Bono! What are you doing down
there?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I slipped and twisted my ankle... I was sure
I'd be able to just climb
right back up,
but...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Maya, when you get to the chapel, could
you get them to send a
medical team
over?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Huh? But if I do that you'll—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'll have to retire from the race.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
But there's no way around it. I can't
possibly reach the goal like this.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ring-a-ding-dong. ☆ I have a halftime
announcement for my beautiful
gemstones
out there. ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
At present, Маяно Топ Ган is closest to
the finish line, with Air
Groove following
close behind!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
I hope you're all going to make a très bien
effort not to lose to the
two of them!
Adieu. ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: I'm in the lead...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Maya! At this rate, you'll
be made a muse for sure!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: So... you can't stop now, right?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: But, but... Bono!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Don't worry about me. I'll be fine!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
But I'll be extra buono if you become a
muse for the two of us. ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
(If I reach the chapel first, Ms. Beauty will
definitely acknowledge me.
I'll be able to
wear a wedding dress and get closer to
becoming a real
lady.)
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: (But Bono's aiming for the same thing...)
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
(I bet she wants to become a muse and
wear a wedding dress too...)
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You two sure are fired up for this.
I'll have to give it my all
too!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
It would be so buono if we could all run in
wedding dresses
together! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: (Ohhh! I don't know what to do!)
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
